summary: Add unwired web Sidebar scale and fault acceptance harnesses with explicit activation prerequisites

replay.detail: Tests exercise exact uncertain-delivery replay; production replay behavior is unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema or persisted format changes.

compatibility.detail: Test-only scale cases cover 1001 and 4096 agents, bounded paging, pending state, deep ancestry, oversized rekeys and UTF-8 operation bytes. Existing Sidebar activation and lazy schema loading are unchanged.

manual.detail: Default tests have no latency assertions. FRACTAL_SIDEBAR_PERF=1 opts into component p95 reporting and a 4 ms planner gate. Browser projection/render, next-frame overlay, v1 comparison and real local-socket initial load remain explicit skipped activation prerequisites. Initial load under sustained writes requires collection-scoped paging D #4739; real 4097th-member admission needs a daemon integration fixture, not D. Scripted metadata stability is not sustained daemon-write evidence.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes or rollback restrictions.
